categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Internet & Smart Hardware and Security. The Internet & Smart Hardware segment includes internet advertising and services, smart hardware sales, internet value-added services, and gaming. The Security segment focuses on enterprise and government network security products, services, and integrated solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include artificial intelligence (AI) with a focus on large language models (LLMs), natural language processing (NLP), and collaboration-of-experts (CoE) architectures. The company develops proprietary AI models such as the 360 Zhinao series and integrates AI with digital security technologies, including cloud-based threat detection and advanced persistent threat (APT) identification. Production methods emphasize cloud computing, big data analytics, and SaaS delivery models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include individual internet users, enterprises, government agencies, and public institutions. The company serves vertical industries such as finance, education, energy, defense, and transportation. The gaming segment targets PC and mobile game users in China. The security segment focuses on national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital transformation clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant presence in major cities including Beijing, Tianjin, and other provincial capitals. It also has overseas subsidiaries and investments, with some operations in Hong Kong, the Cayman Islands, and the US. Overseas revenue and assets represent a smaller portion of total business.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital security and AI technology supply chain. It develops proprietary AI models and software products, provides cloud-based security services, and sells smart hardware devices. It also acts as a platform provider and service integrator for enterprise digital transformation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on the dual pillars of 'AI + Security,' emphasizing AI-driven digital transformation and national cybersecurity. R&D priorities include advancing large-scale AI models, enhancing AI-native internet products, and developing enterprise-grade AI solutions. The company invests heavily in AI safety, cloud security SaaS, and integration of AI with security operations to address emerging cyber threats.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams: internet advertising and services monetized via PC traffic, subscription-based internet value-added services, smart hardware sales combined with cloud service subscriptions, and security product sales and SaaS-based security services. The company is transitioning from primarily advertising-based revenue to increased user subscription and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's internet security and AI sectors, holding a dominant market share in PC security products and browsers. It competes with domestic and international cybersecurity firms and AI technology providers. Its proprietary AI models and integrated security solutions position it as a top-tier innovator in the Chinese market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 7.95 billion, a 12.23% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.09 billion. R&D expenses remain high at over RMB 3.2 billion, accounting for 40.29% of revenue. Total assets stood at RMB 38.26 billion, with net assets of RMB 30.21 billion. The company maintains substantial cash reserves and continues to invest in AI and security capabilities despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its integrated 'AI + Security' approach, leveraging proprietary large AI models to enhance both consumer internet products and enterprise security solutions. Its unique '360 Security Large Model' offers advanced threat detection and response capabilities, free to users of its standard security products. The company emphasizes cloud-based, AI-powered security services and a comprehensive ecosystem that combines high-frequency user data, expert collaboration, and cutting-edge AI to deliver superior digital safety and productivity.
